title: The Heavenly Sovereign's remains
summary: The black paper seals the fragment of the ancient Heavenly Sovereign's remains that was driving the Tornado, and as it fades Liu Ying, Zhou Xuan and Dong Yuan close in on Mu Chen while Xia Youran tries to hold them. Wen Busheng steps in to help, and Mu Chen escapes with a fast movement technique. The fragment opens the Heavenly Sovereign's Remains Realm, where its essence blood nearly bursts Mu Chen's body before flowing into the black paper; his Thunder Body advances to its second pattern, and he learns the black paper is the sealing page of the Immortal Scroll, which shows him a fragment of the Indestructible Solar Body and promises the Primordial Immortal Body, fourth of the 99 Supreme Dharma Bodies, if he finds all four pages. Meanwhile Ji Xuan trades barbs with Luo Li about friendship and power, and his grandfather tells the Holy Son to keep his mind on the plan. On the Nine Heavens Stairway, Mo Xingtian holds the top while Tai Cang and Ling Xi wait; Mu Chen arrives with the Dragon Soaring stage of the Dragon Soaring Art, climbs past everyone who tries to stop him, joins Wen Busheng, and faces Liu Ying's challenge before Mo Xingtian calls his allies to the summit.
